design.alpha_and_k_selection: leave-one-trajectory-out inside the training subset only; held-out trajectories never influence standardization, alpha, or token selection
design.deviation_from_frozen_pipeline: The frozen run used five fixed inner folds of four, which is defined only for exactly 20 training trajectories. D5 substitutes inner leave-one-trajectory-out so a single scheme applies at every subset size. Both are training-only.
design.held_out_sets: original five outer trajectory folds, unchanged
design.readout: layer 4, FULL_TOKEN_GRID and BEST_K, tau1..15, world x
